scope.purpose: Check the incremental historical effect of accepting ZFC independence conditional on arithmetic soundness, alongside unconditional and Con(ZFC)-conditional results.
scope.target_convention: The exact ordinary50-class roster inclusions; both ZFC-unprovability polarities for the same sentence. Oracle,artificial language,alternative encoding or weaker-theory independence does not automatically transfer.
scope.review_depth: Bounded terminology and primary-reference-chain search; not a new exhaustive2500-pair literature audit.

result.historical_carry_forward_recommendation: No identified reason to change the existing candidate decisions solely for this policy extension. Carry them forward explicitly as revisable decisions, recording this incremental screen; do not call this proof of historical completeness.
result.reason_no_new_probability: This bounded policy screen does not provide calibrated evidence for a separate numeric error component or independently recalculate the previous aggregate.

sources.title: Is P Versus NP Formally Independent?
sources.author: Scott Aaronson
sources.review: Primary author PDF directly read at relevant statements.
sources.finding: Hartmanis–Hopcroft independence retains an oracle description, even when its language is extensionally empty. Weak-arithmetic results and cryptographic bounded-arithmetic barriers do not concern independence from ZFC of the fixed ordinary roster statements.

sources.title: On the Independence of P versus NP (revised version)
sources.version: Technion revised technical report; hosted scan has reverse page ordering
sources.review: Relevant theorem statements and proofs inspected; reverse scan ordering distinguished from printed page numbering.
sources.finding: These are consequences/characterizations of hypothetical nonprovability, including almost-polynomial behavior and fixed-size circuit observations. They do not establish independence of NP⊆P or NP⊆Ppoly from ZFC.

sources.title: On the existence of certain total recursive functions in nontrivial axiom systems,I
locators: Abstract and author comments on arXiv
Proposition4.13 and Corollary4.14 in indexed manuscript
sources.review: Original arXiv metadata directly opened; statement checked against indexed full manuscript. No full proof validation claimed.
sources.finding: Claims one direction,ZFC not proving P≠NP under Σ1-soundness. That is insufficient for both-polarity independence, even if granted. Author metadata reports journal rejection concerning an alleged gap/error; this pass does not adjudicate that disputed one-direction proof.

sources.title: On the metamathematics of the P vs.NP question
sources.review: Exact exotic-formulation,extra-hypothesis and concluding passages read.
sources.finding: The exotic sentence includes totality of a fast-growing function. Transferring its consistency to ordinary P=NP requires an additional condition on an extended theory. Full ordinary independence remains a stated expectation;Section8.1 marks a proposed step as not a proof. No admissible two-polarity result follows solely from arithmetic soundness.

sources.title: An Axiomatic Approach to Algebrization
sources.review: Exact theory name,statements and oracle-based proof setup inspected.
sources.finding: Results involving NP/P,BPP,EXP,Ppoly,coNP/MA,NP/BQP,BQP/BPP and QMA/MA are nonderivability in ACT*,using oracle models. ACT* is not ZFC; the theorem cannot resolve ordinary roster independence.

sources.title: On characterizations of learnability with computable learners
sources.author: Tom F.Sterkenburg
sources.review: The arithmetic-soundness premise and target objects checked directly.
sources.finding: Genuine conditional independence concerns learnability of individual computable hypothesis classes. These are not ordered inclusions among the50 benchmark classes.

queries: "On the independence of P versus NP" Ben-David Halevi pdf
"On the existence of certain total recursive functions" da Costa Doria criticism
admission_constraints_confirmed: Arithmetic soundness quantifies all first-order arithmetic sentences and uses standardNat truth; it is stronger than mere consistency.
A stronger assumption yields a weaker conditional metatheorem. Con-conditional independence can be weakened to soundness-conditional,not conversely.
Both unprovability directions share the stated premise; the target theory remains ZFC,not an extension by soundness.
Extra assumptions cannot be hidden in the metatheory or an exotic encoding.
Each exact pair has a separate sentence/certificate binding.
Independence never supplies an ordinary inclusion,separation,Horn premise or complement propagation.
Historical novelty uses the newly accepted premise scope; a pre-cutoff qualifying conditional result would earn zero.

python_findings: Validator requires a permitted premise,nonempty textual theory/metatheory/assumptions/report fields,and standard arithmetic interpretation for the soundness premise.
Certificate list must match exactly all verified independence pairs,with no duplicates,extras or missing pairs.
Evaluator revalidates stored reviews and preserves the premise and matching per-pair certificate in verified_claim_provenance.
Leaderboard independence_results preserves the conditional metadata after Atom normalization.
Ordinary claims still require their isolated Lean verification report; the exception is confined to independence.
lean_findings: Typed syntax prevents free variables in closed sentences. Recursive semantics interpret terms and quantifiers in Nat.
Soundness-to-consistency explicitly requires the contradiction-to-false-arithmetic rule; no unsupported property of an arbitrary proof relation is inferred.
Conditional certificate transport uses newPremise→oldPremise,and both polarities retain that premise.
No concrete ZFC encoding or correctness of a supplied arithmetic translation is asserted.
implementation_review.trust_boundary: The validator checks record shape and bindings,not the truth of expert assertions. A misleading premise or fake two-polarity argument is rejected by mathematical review,not automatically parsed from prose. Synthetic tests are explicitly labeled and were run in temporary fixture repositories; they are not mathematical evidence or real scores.

limitations: Search absence is not a theorem that no qualifying result exists.
The strongest direct coverage is the P/NP independence reference chain and nearby proof-barrier families; not every pair received an individual query.
No qualifying new result appeared in the bounded recent-term queries; these are not a venue census.
Gordeev2010 exotic-formalization note was identified bibliographically but the publisher URL was inaccessible; conclusions do not rely on its uninspected text.
Disputed manuscripts were triaged by scope and stated proof status,not conclusively refuted in this pass.
No release,website,canonical data or implementation file was edited by this reviewer.
